def longest_palindrome_optimized(s):
    if not s:
        return ""
    
    start, end = 0, 0

        # Check for even length palindromes (centered between two characters)

            end = i + max_len // 2
            
    return s[start:end + 1]

def expand_around_center(s, left, right):
    while left >= 0 and right < len(s) and s[left] == s[right]:
        left -= 1
        right += 1
    # Return length. Note: the loop ends when s[left] != s[right]
    # so the actual palindrome is from left+1 to right-1.
    return right - left - 1
